items.answer: During the Q1 FY2027 earnings call, Microsoft described the business model for agents as transitioning from a traditional per-seat business to a model that incorporates both licensing and consumption. This means that while there will still be a per-seat license logic, there will also be a usage-based component, similar to Azure's billing model. The focus is on enhancing productivity through agents, which can create value by either decreasing costs or increasing revenue through improved workflows. This shift reflects a broader understanding that the value derived from agents will come from their effectiveness in completing tasks and driving business outcomes, rather than just from the number of seats licensed [5][8].
